t: This is the Casson Pavilion at London Zoo, in Regent's Park. It is named for Sir Hugh Casson, who designed it. Casson was an architect, interior designer, artist, writer and broadcaster on twentieth-century design. He was director of architecture for the 1951 Festival of Britain, and from 1976 to 1984 he served as president of the Royal Academy. The pavilion is a reminder of his place in postwar British design.
